description: This file declares the interface for a Content Filtering Simple Object, including function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing the object. It is part of a larger system related to content filtering within the BroadWay Service Delivery System.

methods.name: ContFilterCreateSimpleObject
methods.description: Creates a simple object for content filtering.

methods.name: ContFilterSsoCreate
methods.description: Creates a Content Filtering SSO object.

methods.name: ContFilterSsoRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified Content Filtering SSO object.

methods.name: ContFilterSsoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls objects into the Content Filtering SSO.

methods.name: ContFilterSsoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Content Filtering SSO object.
